messages:
kai: Following the postmortem, we should lock down rollout defaults and make auto-rollback predictable. I'm starting a short tracker. Who can take what?
nina: I can own rollout defaults + CLI enforcement. Proposal: new flags default to min_pct=1, step: [1,5,20], max_pct=20, and require a template for >=25%. Will draft RFC and add tests.
omar: I'll tackle auto-rollback semantics. Two modes: warn (pause + alert) and enforce (immediate rollback). Need to decide default for hosted vs dedicated customers.
lena: I'll lead telemetry and regression clustering for ramp periods. We need per-flag health windows and a dashboard. Also adding synthetic spikes for validation.
ci-bot: Linked postmortem: PM-2024-11.
kai: Add tickets and link PRs here. Also call out infra perms (kubectl/controller) if needed.
nina: RFC: https://go/redwood/rfcs/rollout-defaults (draft). Includes a CLI flag --force-full for power users and an approval gate.
omar: Prototype config in staging:
```
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  mode: warn # warn | enforce
  error_rate_threshold: 3% # rolling 1m
  cooldown: 5m
```
Pushed as canary-rollback-experiment build 4720.
lena: Dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/321 adds per-flag ramp view and clusters.
kai: Plan check: nina RFC by Tue, omar prototype by Wed, lena dashboard by Wed, validation run Thu. We'll run a 15-min injected-failure test in staging to verify rollback and alerting.
nina: I'll also add a guard that prevents immediate 100% deploys unless explicitly approved by a release lead.
omar: Note recurring pattern: KV cache growth causing latency spikes during ramps. I'll add a mitigation hook to drain/evict cache on rollback.
lena: Scheduling the validation: Thu 11:00 UTC. Invite sent. Please RSVP.
ci-bot: Deployment: canary-rollback-experiment -> staging (deployer: omar, build: 4720).
kai: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and paste PR/JIRA links. We'll do a short retro after the validation to finalize defaults.
